# Quickomate
> AI automation agency for B2B companies. Builds cold email infrastructure, AI lead generation, LLM agents, and sales automation systems — all client-owned, no retainers.

Quickomate is an AI automation agency and AI Growth Partner for fast-moving B2B companies. Founded by Vasu Gupta, Quickomate designs and deploys custom AI automation, LLM agents, workflow automation, and B2B lead-generation systems that clients own outright. The core philosophy: build infrastructure you keep, not a service you rent.

Target clients: US/global B2B founders, sales leaders, and operators at companies doing $1M–$20M ARR who want to scale pipeline and operations without hiring more SDRs or manual ops headcount.

## Services

- [AI Automation Agency](https://quickomate.com/ai-automation-agency): Custom AI workflows, LLM agents, CRM automation, and process automation for B2B companies. Built on n8n, Make, Clay, and custom LLM stacks.
- [Cold Email Agency](https://quickomate.com/cold-email-agency): Done-for-you cold email infrastructure targeting 15–20 qualified B2B appointments per month. Realistic 4% reply rates. Client owns all domains, inboxes, and lead lists.
- [B2B Lead Generation Agency](https://quickomate.com/b2b-lead-generation-agency): AI-powered lead generation combining Clay enrichment, Apollo targeting, waterfall email verification, and AI-assisted personalization at scale.

## Founder

Vasu Gupta — AI systems architect and founder of Quickomate. Builds systems, not retainers. Serves US/global B2B teams.
